title: Dimension-Free PAC-Bayes Generalization for Deep Neural Networks via Dirichlet Processes
abstract: arXiv:2610.21340v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Classical PAC-Bayesian generalization theory places prior distributions over Euclidean parameter space $\Theta \subseteq \mathbb{R}^D$, causing relative entropy to scale with network dimension $D$. For modern overparameterized neural networks where $D \gg n$, this parameter-counting dependency yields vacuous generalization bounds ($> 1{,}000\%$). In this work, we resolve this barrier by shifting prior specification from internal parameters to the non-parametric space of data distributions $\mathcal{M}_1(\mathcal{Z})$ via a \textbf{Dirichlet Process (DP)}, $\mathcal{DP}(\alpha, F_0)$, inducing parameter distributions through push-forward measures under the learning algorithm. By the Data Processing Inequality, parameter-space relative entropy is strictly bounded by the data-space DP divergence, which we evaluate in exact closed form using Digamma functions. translated_title: 基于狄利克雷过程的深度神经网络维度无关PAC-Bayes泛化
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.21340v1 公告类型：cross 摘要：经典的PAC-Bayesian泛化理论将先验分布置于欧氏参数空间 $\Theta \subseteq \mathbb{R}^D$ 上，导致相对熵随网络维度 $D$ 增长。对于现代过参数化神经网络（其中 $D \gg n$），这种基于参数计数的依赖性产生了空洞的泛化界（超过1,000%）。在本工作中，我们通过狄利克雷过程 $\mathcal{DP}(\alpha, F_0)$ 将先验设定从内部参数转移到数据分布的非参数空间 $\mathcal{M}_1(\mathcal{Z})$，并通过学习算法下的前推测度诱导出参数分布，从而突破了这一障碍。根据数据处理不等式，参数空间的相对熵被数据空间的DP散度严格上界约束，我们利用Digamma函数以精确闭式形式对该散度进行计算。所得到的PAC-Bayesian证书对网络参数严格不变（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文通过狄利克雷过程将PAC-Bayes分析的先验从高维参数空间转移到数据分布空间，并借助数据处理不等式证明参数空间相对熵被可闭式计算的数据空间DP散度严格界定，从而获得了与网络维度无关的深度神经网络泛化界，解决了过参数化网络泛化界空洞的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper achieves dimension-free PAC-Bayes generalization bounds for deep neural networks by shifting the prior from Euclidean parameter space to the space of data distributions via Dirichlet Processes, proving that parameter-space relative entropy is strictly bounded by a closed-form data-space DP divergence, thereby resolving the vacuous bounds afflicting overparameterized networks.
